_comment: Baseline violation counts for scripts/lint-narration.ts, measured against the
27-script corpus as it stood before the voice pass. The linter fails only when
a count goes UP, so these numbers are a ratchet: lower them as beats get fixed,
and never raise one without explaining why in the commit message.
anchor-integrity is pinned at 0 and must stay there — an events[].at.word that
is not in the narration does not throw, it silently fires at 30% of the beat.
Prose rules that a linter cannot judge live in context/narration-voice.md.
